**Diagnostics**

These print what the app can see. They contain no credentials and are safe to paste.

```
/Applications/Brim.app/Contents/MacOS/Brim --diagnose-claude
/Applications/Brim.app/Contents/MacOS/Brim --diagnose-screen
/Applications/Brim.app/Contents/MacOS/Brim --diagnose-tools
```

Use `--diagnose-screen` for anything about where the notch sits, and
`--diagnose-tools` for a tool you described yourself.
